metadata.title: 坠入星河的帷幕 · V24 local preview arrangement
metadata.event_method: Only existing full-track events mapped through the actual arrangement tracks; no new event recognition and no invented drum notes.
metadata.feature_method: Existing full-track features interpolated at mapped source times and mixed by squared track gain; measured_mix_rms_db is independently measured from the actual arranged PCM in a50ms centered window. Features at crossfades are estimates, not a spectral reanalysis.

tempo.method: spectral onset autocorrelation, fine periodic phase concentration; octave ambiguity retained

timeMap.purpose: local preview music arrangement only; no video encoding

processing.mapping_precision: Exact output sample anchors; local WSOLA source-time map is nominal, not sample-correspondence; event uncertainty is explicitly retained.

musical_evidence.ending_description: Existing full-track section novelty marks a transition at 117.00s. The last strong 116.796372s onset is kept before the 116.85–117.10s source fade across the drop.
musical_evidence.subjective_listening_status: Candidate section boundary based on existing feature analysis and onset detection.
